title: Make the two silence-restart liveness tests assert that a silence restart is pending
outcome: The tests 'keeps a stream that delivers again before its silence restart fires' and 'still restarts a stream that closed while a silence restart was pending' (ui/src/App.live-state.reconnect-backoff.test.tsx) check that a silence restart is scheduled at the computed watchdog tick, so neither can pass vacuously if the tick drifts. The second test also gets the watchdogStarts length guard.
acceptance: Make the two silence-restart liveness tests assert that a silence restart is pending is done
